title: Niagara Falls and Niagara-on-the-Lake Ultimate Day Tour
includes: Floral Clock & Queenston Heights, Niagara on the Lake, ON
Maple syrup, fudge, and chocolate tasting experience by CFX Chocolatiers
Journey Behind the Falls admission when boat not operating (November-April)
Priority access to Niagara City Cruises Voyage to the Falls (May-November)
Close up view at Table Rock
Convenient pickup and drop-off - Niagara Parks Welcome Centre Clifton Hill
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Seasonal note: Niagara City Cruises runs roughly May–Nov; dates vary by weather. When the boat isn’t operating, we substitute Journey Behind the Falls. If the boat is running on your date, you’ll do the boat. Journey is only used when the boat stops.
Itinerary is subject to change without notice
Vehicle type is subject to change based on passenger volumes
Tour is subject to cancellation if we do not meet the minimum required amount of participants
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Niagara Falls, Canada on a full-day tour blending iconic sights with local gems. Begin with priority access to the Niagara City Cruises boat ride, sailing into the mist of Horseshoe Falls for unforgettable views (poncho included).

Afterward, enjoy free time at Table Rock Centre—the closest land viewpoint—before a narrated drive along the Niagara Parkway with photo stops at Whirlpool Rapids and drive-by highlights like the Floral Clock, Queenston Heights, and the generation stations. 

Sample maple syrup, fudge, and artisan chocolate at Maple Leaf Place, as well as a Canadian market theme lunch

From November–April, the boat is replaced with Journey Behind the Falls, featuring dramatic tunnel views from inside the cascades.
